messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Automated detection — alert delivery & ack telemetry anomalies observed. Multiple high-sev alerts created but PagerDuty delivery latency >120s and some ack events missing/duplicated. Root alert INC-9382. Tagging on-call. PD status: https://status.pagerduty.com/ (reports degraded API)

PagerDuty Bot: PagerDuty incident created: PD-2026-032. Webhook retries observed; 503s reported. Escalation path attempted.

Jamie (SRE): I'm seeing a pattern: our webhook ingestion shows delayed webhook timestamps and duplicate attempt ids. Example from logs:
```
[2026-01-25T12:04:01Z] pd-webhook id=abc123 recv=2026-01-25T12:02:50Z
[2026-01-25T12:04:30Z] pd-webhook id=abc123 recv=2026-01-25T12:04:29Z (retry)
```
Seems PD is retrying and we're getting duplicates + large gap.

Priya (Oncall): oncall here — calling PD support now. @Jamie can you check if our routing rules changed? also enabling fallback runbook.

Jamie (SRE): no routing changes on our side. Routing table looks normal. I can see a spike in webhook latency starting ~12:01Z. PD's status page shows "High latency for REST API and Webhooks". Looks like third-party.

Luis (Eng-Oncall): I'm toggling our alert-fallback to email->sms for critical alerts (runbook: alert-fallback-v2). Command I'm running (internal tool):
```
./alertctl set-fallback --policy critical --provider sms
```
Applying now, will DM phone rota for manual calls if needed.

Marta (Prod Support): Customer impact check — monitoring customer-facing incidents. So far no drop in API throughput, only delayed operator pages. I'll prepare a short status note to send to affected customers if pages remain delayed beyond 30m.

Priya (Oncall): PD support on the line said they're seeing internal delivery backlog due to "downstream delivery queuing". They opened a support case PD-CASE-3141 and asked us to temporarily avoid large burst alerts and route critical only.

Jamie (SRE): reducing noise: applying temporary suppression for non-critical alerts for 20m. Patch:
```
/alerts suppress --filter="severity!=critical" --duration=20m
```

PagerDuty Bot: Acknowledgement events from some mobile devices are not reaching us reliably; this looks like PD->mobile push provider degradation.

Luis (Eng-Oncall): manual escalations: I'm calling the phone tree for the 2 engineers on current rota. Also posting a short message to the #oncall-phone channel with duty list.

Marta (Prod Support): Drafting customer blast: "We're investigating delayed operator notifications due to PagerDuty service degradation; no customer API impact detected. We'll update in 30 minutes." Will post to status page if PD doesn't resolve.

Priya (Oncall): Handoff plan: I'm handing this to Luis for the next 2h while I join PD call and coordinate with support. Key items for next oncall:
- Keep fallback SMS enabled
- Monitor duplicate webhook spikes (metrics: pd.webhook.latency, pd.webhook.duplicates)
- Update PD case PD-CASE-3141 and paste our webhook logs

Jamie (SRE): added a short script to dedupe webhook deliveries on our side to avoid duplicate alert executions while PD is noisy. Temp mitigation applied.

PagerDuty Bot: PD status updated: partial recovery reported; still observing increased latencies. ETA unknown.

Luis (Eng-Oncall): Confirming handoff accepted. I'll keep monitoring and coordinate with Marta for customer comms. If ack gaps persist, next step is to switch to phone-only routing for critical alerts and file an incident postmortem.

Marta (Prod Support): Will prepare an incident timeline and notify sales/CS teams. If customers ask, message: "Operator pages delayed due to third-party alerting provider issues. We're actively using fallback channels." (shortened)

Incident Bot: Incident declared SEV-2 for alerting pipeline. Actions: fallback enabled, suppression active, PD case linked PD-CASE-3141.

Priya (Oncall): leaving detailed notes in the incident doc and tagging on-call rotation for after-hours: @Luis please escalate to leadership if this persists >45m.

Luis (Eng-Oncall): Will do. Will also keep an eye for any correlated errors from our webhook processing (timeouts / 429s). Logging additional metrics to #observability for post-incident analysis.

Marta (Prod Support): Update at +30m: PD reports "performance improving"; we still have occasional duplicates but delivery latency down to ~30s. Customers notified via status.reddit? sorry status.redwood.ai (link placeholder) — posted.

Jamie (SRE): removing temporary dedupe script after PD confirmed steady state. Will include timeline and root-cause notes in postmortem. Preliminary RCA points to PD webhook queueing/backlog causing retries and duplicate attempts.

Priya (Oncall): closing active handoff — leaving Luis as follow-up owner for postmortem. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:

Luis (Eng-Oncall): Acknowledged. I'll collect logs, timeline, and send a draft postmortem by EOD.
